description: This Java source file defines the class 'JsonExamplesProducer', which generates JSON examples for various policy-related objects and exceptions in the Eclipse Ditto project. It creates JSON files representing policies, query/response commands, modifications, and exceptions, primarily for testing or documentation purposes.

classes.name: JsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class that generates sample JSON representations of policies, query commands, responses, modifications, and exceptions for testing and documentation in the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that invokes JSON generation based on CLI argument specifying output directory.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the JSON generation process, handling argument validation.

methods.name: produce
methods.description: Produces JSON files under specified root path, organizing into policies and exceptions directories.

methods.name: producePolicyCommands
methods.description: Generates policy query and modification command JSON files and their responses.

methods.name: producePolicyQueryCommands
methods.description: Creates JSON files for policy-related query commands.

methods.name: producePolicyQueryResponse
methods.description: Creates JSON files for responses to policy query commands.

methods.name: producePolicyModifyCommands
methods.description: Creates JSON files for policy modification commands.

methods.name: producePolicyModifyResponse
methods.description: Creates JSON files for responses to policy modification commands.

methods.name: producePolicyExceptions
methods.description: Generates JSON files for various policy-related exceptions.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a Jsonifiable object to a JSON string and writes it to the specified file.
